response.sql:
WITH account_order_counts AS (
    SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count
    FROM `order`
    GROUP BY account_id
), above_average AS (
    SELECT account_id, order_count
    FROM account_order_counts
    WHERE order_count > (SELECT AVG(order_count) FROM account_order_counts)
)
SELECT
    account_id,
    order_count,
    order_count - (SELECT AVG(order_count) FROM account_order_counts) AS above_overall_average,
    order_count - (SELECT AVG(order_count) FROM above_average) AS above_kept_average
FROM above_average
ORDER BY above_kept_average DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: “Average number of orders per account” is the unweighted average across accounts that have at least one order, as specified in the request.
